# Method DeactivateProjectSecurity

#### DeactivateProjectSecurity(PdmObjectId)

Deactivates security of a project.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 8, 302, 60)]

```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- |
